about: sigelo-msg/0 envelopes (design/relay-plan.md §3, §11 "Epoch recovery"). Rebuild the receivers from the seeds (gen-envelope.mjs receivers(), each holding envelopes `params.hold` seconds), run `steps` in order: open `envelope` (hex) on its `topic` at its `now`, after `xor` [offset, mask] (negative offset counts from the end), `set` [offset, hex] or `truncate` (bytes cut from the end), then, with `rebind`, set the epoch id (bytes 2..17) to the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of bytes 22..1157 (prekey id and X-Wing ciphertext, as a sender derives it), and compare `expect` plus the envelope's `body` by value, or `error` by check name. `contact`: the receiver's store has merged `rotation`; its peer record becomes { did: original, current_did, current_key } as SPEC §9 resolves that chain, and `current` names the identity it must resolve to.

params.epoch_id: the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(prekey id ‖ X-Wing ciphertext)
params.padding: ISO/IEC 7816-4: 0x80 then 0x00 to the next multiple of 256
params.carries: 0x80 in the kind byte: the header carries the prekey id and X-Wing ciphertext (bytes 22..1157). Always at counter 0; at later counters until the sender has opened a reply, an envelope from the contact signed 300 s or more after the epoch began. A receiver begins an unknown epoch from any envelope that carries it.

e01.note: first of epoch 1: carries one-time prekey keys[0]

e02.note: non-ASCII content, JCS order; carries the encapsulation again: no reply yet

e04.note: the last of epoch 1 that carries the encapsulation

r01.note: Bob's reply, on his own epoch begun on Alice's keys[0]

e05.note: after Bob's reply: no encapsulation; the tamper target

e06.note: signed by Alice, addressed to Carol, sealed to Bob

e07.note: Alice's body signed with Carol's key

e08.note: from Alice's new current DID A1: her rotation begins epoch 2, on keys[1]

e09.note: signed with the key Alice rotated away from

e10.note: counter 73: more than the window past what Bob opened; opens, and keys 1..8 are deleted

e11.note: epoch 2 is 7 days old: epoch 3 on keys[2], next week's topic

e12.note: a sender restored from state older than e01: keys[0] again

e13.note: the second message of that refused epoch, carrying its encapsulation too

e14.note: every one-time key used: the last-resort key, flagged

e15.note: later messages of that epoch are flagged too

e16.note: a body field outside the message row

e17.note: plaintext in insertion order, not JCS

e21.note: counter 0 of epoch 4, delivered after e22

e22.note: counter 1 of epoch 4, carrying the encapsulation: it begins the epoch at Bob

e19.note: Alice's signed e08 re-sealed by a holder of K on a fresh encapsulation to keys[10], under e08's epoch id

e20.note: the same under the epoch id its encapsulation gives

steps.note: X-Wing ciphertext edited: it no longer hashes to the epoch id, refused before any decapsulation
